summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K providing a routine operational update on aircraft deliveries for Q2 2026. The report discloses 65 total deliveries (20 commercial, 45 executive) with quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year comparisons, along with reaffirmed full-year guidance. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situations activity is mentioned. This is a standard periodic business update, not a classified special situation.
